prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(no tests finished yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move sign-in to after pet customization and adoption so users build emotional attachment before account creation. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion and long median time (89s), while upfront sign_in drops 27.1% of users before they even select a pet.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Creator Grid: Redesign pet picking into a dynamic split view featuring interactive personality cards and high-resolution live preview. (why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% and 3 support emails reported confusion or issues with pet custom appearance.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Screen: Insert a dedicated walkthrough screen showing how to summon, control, talk to, and hide the pet on the desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion about pet controls after onboarding and finish completion is only 64.8% with 395s median time.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Upload Live Preview & Adjuster: Add an instant pet render preview step during photo upload so users can inspect and refine their custom pet render. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to adoption drop-off.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Save Safeguard Notice: Add explicit copy explaining that signing in protects pet data from being lost or reset upon app updates or restarts. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch & Permission Progress Info: Show step-by-step progress status and display troubleshooting tips while waiting for the pet to spawn on the desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop / app failing to open, and home stage median wait time is 201s.)
6: [finish, hint] System Tray & Shortcut Guide Hint: Highlight the system tray location and keyboard shortcut for re-summoning the pet on the final welcome screen. (why: Support logged 3 emails on pets not appearing on desktop and 3 emails on confusion around hiding and showing pets.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Animated Story Stage Layout: Transform the initial story introduction into a centered stage layout with an auto-playing pet animation preview. (why: Story and choose_path steps take a mean time of 514s, showing users take long to engage with static text.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Certificate Naming Redesign: Redesign adoption certificate into a spotlight stage where users input their pet's name and choose a badge stamp. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and adding active participation improves ownership and completion.)

scores.note: Deferring auth until after commitment reduces early drop-off, though requires flow restructuring.
Redesigning pet creation directly targets adoption, the largest bottleneck (39.1% loss).
Walkthrough screen solves post-onboarding control confusion but introduces an additional step.
Live preview adjuster fixes generation issues during adoption but requires custom editor UI.
Config copy change directly addresses the top support ticket topic (8 emails) with minimal effort.
Progress info and tips alleviate drop-off during the long 201s home screen wait time.
Hint on final screen addresses 6 support complaints about missing pets at zero release cost.
Animated layout engages users taking long on choose_path, but lacks support ticket evidence.
Interactive certificate increases user ownership during adoption, boosting completion.
